_stamp: [2026-10-24 09:07 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.134 W1 (doc 20, R-TWIN-VAULT TV-0…9) — Twin Vault · Kho tri thức: the Markdown + YAML store of one site (tenant), every note traceable to its Journal row by source_ref. Runtime JSON (core/kg-hub/contracts): code = BizCity_Twin_Vault (+ BizCity_Brain_Vault_Store for files, BizCity_Journal_MCP_Tools::vault_get); docs/ is never read at runtime.
principle: Biến tài liệu, hình ảnh và thông tin thành những bản ghi có cấu trúc, dễ đọc, dễ liên kết, dễ chỉnh sửa và có thể truy vết về nguồn gốc.
format: Markdown + YAML frontmatter; frontmatter schema twin-vault@1 (brain-markdown@1 read as an alias)
storage: per tenant: library <uploads>/bizcity-skills/<blog_id>/ (same paths as the old skill library) + Vault Store <BIZCITY_VAULT_ROOT|uploads/bizcity-vault>/<blog_id>/<namespace>/ for readable copies of Journal rows

ids.src: src:TL-47 — the readable copy of one Journal row (also accepts TL-47@v2)

document.label: Tài liệu
document.from: Journal rows of layer document / output with a file

note.label: Ghi chú
note.from: common.note · common.instruction · task.minutes · grp.brief + library /note · /nhat-ky · /content · any other folder

routes.GET /tree: view=folders|types (default folders: roots + folders{home,list}); six roots by type
routes.POST /folder: label · icon? · access? (edit_posts; the site gives the next number 10-90)
routes.PATCH /folder/{nn}: label? · icon? · access? · rules{keywords[],groups[]}? · gurus[]? (access / gurus: owner only)
routes.POST /move: id · folder ("" = out of every folder); edit_posts; folder access gated both ways
routes.POST /note: id? · path? · title · markdown · frontmatter? · expected_updated? (edit_posts; 409 vault_conflict; 400 vault_path_refused for /skills · /tools)

mcp.vault.get: brain.read · content.read (ref TL-47 or id lib:/…)
mcp.vault.write: memory.write · write (notes only, never skills / readable copies)
mcp.vault.move: memory.write · write (only when the owner asks; never a skill)

folders.frontmatter_projection: materialized readable copies also carry group{gid,ref,name} · contact_id · folder from the Journal row (PHASE-0.136 S136-G6; the row stays the source)
folders.defaults_merge: a default whose number is free is added to a saved list on read (PHASE-0.136)
folders.aliases: ≤ 12 names per folder; vault.move / vault.write / vault.list accept a folder NUMBER or NAME (label / alias, folded, whole words, longest wins); unknown name ⇒ vault_folder_invalid

access.effect: owner: every row. staff: not rows of owner folders — tree, list, search, note (403 vault_folder_denied), graph, filing into it; brain-access decide() gives staff / automation / group_member nothing on a row filed in an owner folder
access.public: stored; no public door exists yet (a later phase)

folders.find: journal.find {folder} and context_scope.folder narrow only (prefix; disagreeing values ⇒ empty)
folders.rules: keywords (folded, whole words, ≤ 20) · Zalo group ids (≤ 10) ⇒ folder_suggest {n,label,icon,why[]} on an unfiled note / view=card; site code, no model; a person files it
folders.gurus: guru ids (≤ 10) ⇒ guru-context@1 scope.vault_folders (optional; etag unchanged when empty)
folders.stored: library note: frontmatter folder · Journal row: metadata.meta.folder (entry-meta@1, optional)

journal: a vault.write opens / updates exactly one Journal row common.note (idempotency vault:<blog>:<md5(path)[0:24]>, source_type vault, card.vault_path); the site writes its source_ref into the frontmatter (TV-2, TV-3)
compat: REST bizcity/skill/v1 + window.skillAppConfig unchanged; skill files edited by the Steps editor; no file moved
